chunks: For God the likeness of Jesus is as that of Adam whom He fashioned out of dust and said "Be" and he was.
ai.seo_question: How is the creation of Jesus compared to Adam in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (Ayat al-Mithal) is pivotal in affirming the humanity of Jesus (Isa) and refuting claims of his divinity or sonship, as both Adam and Jesus were created directly by God's command ('Kun') without a father. It underscores that their miraculous origins do not elevate them above the status of created servants, but rather highlight Allah's absolute power to create from nothing. This comparison serves as a theological anchor for the concept of Tawhid, ensuring that the miraculous nature of Jesus' birth is seen as a sign of God's will rather than an intrinsic divine attribute.
